headline: Sao Paulo GDP Grows 1.5% Through August Driven by Agriculture and Services
summary: The economy of Sao Paulo advanced 1.5% through August, with a 0.9% year-on-year growth in August, driven by the agricultural and service sectors according to Fundação Seade.
why: Sao Paulo is the primary economic engine of Brazil; tracking its regional GDP and sectoral performance offers critical insights into broader Brazilian economic trends.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Growth in Brazil's largest state economy supports national economic indicators.
